capture.environment: Codex in-app browser on localhost, single manual session

interpretation.inp: The 168 ms value is the maximum observed Event Timing duration in one local session. It is not a reported INP metric; official INP remains UNKNOWN.
interpretation.timer: Background and locked-screen timer drift was not measured in this browser run; the implementation derives remaining time from a persisted wall-clock end timestamp.
interpretation.scope: Single-machine localhost observations are qualification fixtures, not a cross-device or physical-mobile performance claim.
